plan.title: Start-now event is Live and immediately biddable

steps.note: Create a valid event using the default Auction stage.
Give the event a unique searchable title.
Apply a pricing template before adding items.
Provide one item for the vendor to quote.
Save the default start-now schedule with a 30-minute duration.
Invite a vendor using the configured audience without inventing a company name.
Publish the event with its committed schedule.
Confirm publication reached a real project page.
Confirm the list rendered without an error.
Assert the newly published event is Live rather than Upcoming.
Submit from the configured vendor portal immediately, without waiting or changing the schedule.
Confirm the vendor's bid was accepted during the new window.
